name: Document Explainer
description: Turns uploaded documents (PDF, Word, TXT, Markdown) into a narrated explainer video: the Palette LLM reads and analyses them, writes the narration and the drawings, and explainroo renders them on this computer (Kokoro voice, Whisper word timing, Chrome drawing, ffmpeg) with music, subtitles, chapters and a cover.
best_for: explaining an uploaded PDF, report, paper, manual or notes
charts of a document's real numbers
step-by-step diagrams of a process described in a document
not_good_for: photoreal people, places or live action (use Flow Video or Storyboard & Video)
profile_notes: Added 2026-11-17. explainroo 0.6.0 runs locally through npx (Node 20.11+, ffmpeg, Chrome); the first run downloads Kokoro and Whisper (~400 MB). Tested 2026-11-17: an 80 s 1080p explainer rendered in 1 min 41 s at fast quality and passed verify. The LLM-written scenes.js is refused if it uses network, eval or dynamic imports.
